content:
**Down Ranger**, formerly **Rifleman**, is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Increased ranged damage to far enemies.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | You do +20% ranged damage to far enemies. | 0004A0B8 | 
| ★★ | 2 | You do +15% ranged damage to far enemies. | 0004A0B7 | 
| ★ | 1 | You do +10% ranged damage to far enemies. | 0004A0B6 | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Rifleman." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to non-automatic rifles.
